sections.description: A complete restaurant menu management system with multiple menus, categories, featured items, dietary badges, photo support, shortcodes, and Google Schema.org structured data.
sections.changelog:
1.6.0

  • Fixed frontend and admin drag-and-drop sort — status selector, array POST format, sortable initialization order, event handler rebinding

1.5.9

  • Per-menu drag-and-drop sort order — reorder items from the frontend (admin toggle) or wp-admin list table (filter to a menu then drag)
  • Sort stored per-menu in _rmm_sort_order_by_menu, global _rmm_sort_order remains as fallback

1.5.8

  • Added frontend inline editing for logged-in editors — pencil icon on hover opens an inline panel to edit Name, Price, Description, Section, Availability, and Featured without going to wp-admin

1.5.7

  • Item Name and Price now have independent font-size controls — added --rmm-font-size-price CSS custom property
  • Typography class name placeholders updated from rcc_ to rmm_ prefix
  • Author updated to Lou Griffith, plugin URI updated to lougriffith.com

1.5.6

  • Fixed Restaurant Information fields overflowing — stacked label-above-input layout, inputs 100% width

1.5.5

  • Settings layout: Quick Start top-left, Restaurant Info top-right, rmm_ class placeholders

1.5.4

  • Fixed Filter by Menu and shortcode PHP serialization mismatch

1.5.3

  • Settings redesign with Typography class name controls

1.5.2

  • Added [rmm_info] shortcode

1.5.1

  • Fixed plugin slug and update URL

1.5.0

  • Layout shortcode attribute, [rmm_featured_item], typography controls

1.0.0

  • Initial release
